reject.text_heavy: The picture has too much text.

reject.alcoholFix: Take drinks out of the words and picture.

reject.personal_attributesFix: Describe the event, not the person reading.
reject.misleading: The words promise more than the event gives.
reject.misleadingFix: Keep the words to what people really get.
reject.landing_page: The app couldn't open your page, or it didn't match the ad.
reject.landing_pageFix: Check the page is public and matches the ad.
reject.low_quality: The video or photo is too low quality.
reject.low_qualityFix: Use a sharper video or photo.
reject.identity: The app needs proof you can use this name or picture.
reject.identityFix: Use your own brand name and media you own.
reject.prohibited: It shows something the app doesn't allow.
reject.prohibitedFix: Remove that part of the picture or words.
